messages:

Thanks,
Alex
Customer Success / Acme AI

Thanks for the heads up, Alex — sorry for the friction. I'm looping in Marissa (Growth) and Dev (Platform) to triage.

Karthik

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Dev — Alex pasted the promo link in the ticket. It should map to promotion id: PROMO-PLG-FALL26.

Quick asks:
- Can you check the grants processing pipeline (ingest -> index -> wallet cache) for any lag or errors around 2026-10-01T09:05-09:20?
- If the grant exists but failed the wallet cache write, what’s the ETA for a repair job?

Alex — we’ll try to provide a timeline ASAP and either manually apply the grant or run a repair if needed.

Marissa
Growth Manager, PLG

From: dev_patel@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-02T14:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Promo grant visibility — initial triage

Root cause summary from logs:
- The grant record for user alex+acme (signup_id: s_8fh2k) was created in GrantsDB at 2026-10-01T09:06:12Z.
- The indexer job that pushes grant ids to the Wallet Cache failed (OOM) during a GC spike and retried — the retry window exceeded our 30s front-end RPC timeout, so the frontend returned an empty state to the user's UI.
- There is an intermittent deserialization warning for a legacy promo field (promo_meta_v1) that caused the indexer to skip that record in the first pass; it was retried but the retry didn't finish before the user's initial view.

Remediation plan:
1) Manual repair: run a targeted reindex for signup_id s_8fh2k (ETA: 2 hours).
2) Short-term fix: increase indexer memory for the next 24 hours to prevent OOM on the backlog (ETA: immediate).
3) Medium-term: add safe-deserialize path for promo_meta_v1 (tracked INF-7543).

I will kick off the manual reindex and post logs when complete.

Dev
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- grant-reindex-plan.txt (text/plain)

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Alex Park <alex@acme-ai.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-02T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Promo grant missing from billing wallet — next steps

Alex — quick update: Dev confirmed the grant exists and we’re running a targeted reindex now. Estimated completion within 2 hours; once the wallet cache receives the entry you should see the promo balance immediately. If you prefer we can also manually grant the balance from the console so you can continue testing sooner.

Apologies again for the interruption — we’ll follow up when the entry is visible.

Karthik
Director, Growth Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Park <alex@acme-ai.com>

Subject: Re: Promo grant missing from billing wallet — confirmation

Thanks team — reindex completed and I can now see the promo balance in the wallet. Appreciate the quick turnaround and the explanation.

One quick ask for follow-up: can the engineering team add a consumer-friendly error in the signup flow when the wallet data is stale (e.g., "Promo applied — finalizing wallet; refresh in a few seconds")? That would avoid confusion for future signups.

Cheers,
Alex
Acme AI
